name: In Tune with Nature
body:
The Weather Witch has given you insight into the workings of the natural world.

Prerequisite: Patron deity is a nature god

Benefit: You receive a +2 divine bonus to Handle Animal and Knowledge (Nature), and Knowledge (Nature) is always a class skill for you.

The Book of Divine Magic. Copyright 2009, 4 Winds Fantasy Gaming; Authors Connie J. Thomson and Robert W. Thomson, with Katheryn Bauer and Sean O’Connor.
